_source: Stage 5 (Claude Code, 07.10). Delivery = the old site's rules [OBSERVED] /order 03.10 + 06.10 (FACTS „Delivery rules”), as lexicon §5.5 already states them on the site: delivery minimum €50, free within 10 km, from €100 free within 20 km, €1/km beyond, Monday–Saturday, slots 18:00–19:30. Zones = the places lexicon §5.11 („Leveren jullie in Tielt / Lichtervelde / Roeselare?”, revised 07.10) puts in a ring, with their postcodes; any other postcode → „Bel ons”. Per-km distances are not known, so a fee beyond a free ring is not computed (the slip shows [LEVERKOST]). Pickup: no same-day order (`cutoff` null — the 12:00 cut-off is D6, unconfirmed; with a time here, today is offered until then), 30-min steps, 14 days ahead. D6: every line to confirm with the owners; Cowork owns this file from here.
